# Flick — Smart App Control signed candidate qualification (AntiGravity TEST ONLY)

## Test contract

Use the exact current trusted main SHA and the private candidate generated by signed-windows-qa.yml only AFTER the owner enrolls with a CA Public Trust certificate. Do NOT use the unsigned v1.0.2-preview.2 installer as if it were newly signed.

**AntiGravity tests, never codes.** Do not edit source, branches, workflows or release files. Never disable Smart App Control, Windows Defender or Code Integrity and do not install an untrusted certificate to artificially pass. Use isolated Windows 11 x64/NVIDIA hardware, synthetic fixtures and no real Discord message transmission.

1. Fetch and read docs/WINDOWS-TRUST-AND-SMART-APP-CONTROL.md, docs/OPEN-SOURCE-RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md, installer/Flick.iss, all signing scripts and previous Windows GUI/hardware handoffs.
2. Verify exact source SHA, pinned third-party input hashes, portable ZIP, signed Setup EXE, SHA256SUMS.txt and publisher signature identities. Record full signed Authenticode chain, timestamp, trusted root and current file digests. Include signed unins000.exe after installation.
3. Keep Smart App Control ON/enforcement. Launch and install the signed Setup EXE, start Flick in normal/tray modes, manually arm source, save NVENC replay, preview/trim, export local Discord MP4, stop recording and uninstall via each supported route.
4. Inspect Windows Event Viewer > Applications and Services Logs > Microsoft > Windows > CodeIntegrity > Operational for 3077 block and 3076 audit events. Test all app feature paths; an empty GUI error log alone does not prove trust. Distinguish SAC vs SmartScreen vs Defender malware/PUA findings.
5. Execute existing 120 offline + 7 real hardware test suite on RTX 5060; test FPS/1% lows, performance, UI scaling 100/125/150/200%, startup opt-in, privacy, capture-source safety and 2h/8h endurance only if user authorized.
6. Repeat installed-app Settings > General > Uninstall Flick, Start Menu and Installed Apps uninstall. Verify active worker/tray exit, normal and optional settings/cache cleanup, and byte-identical preserved clips/exports/imported originals; no unrelated data erased.
7. Provide a consolidated PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED matrix, exact commands, timestamps and redacted code-integrity events. Report specific unsigned/blocked file paths, certificates, installer SHA, and recommended fix. No source edits or public-release actions.

A full public/stable release requires owner approval and complete licensing and historical-publication review, not merely a passing signature check.
